scenes.title: The Euphoria & The Hidden Wire
scenes.purpose: Establish high optimism, rapid green retail gains on mobile screens, and the hidden danger: massive margin debt leverage.
scenes.visual: A sleek dark mobile trading terminal displaying green candlestick surges and growing portfolio numbers, before the camera tilts down to reveal a glowing amber warning: 3X MARGIN DEBT.

layout.portrait: Top telemetry HUD, center hero mobile viewport with rising green chart, bottom debt meter

transition_out.continuity: The glowing margin debt meter expands and morphs directly into the liquidation trigger gauge

scenes.title: The Trap Snaps
scenes.purpose: Show the sudden shock of a 2% dip instantly obliterating collateral and triggering automated algorithm dump orders.
scenes.visual: The green chart line cracks and drops violently across a red horizontal breach line. An amber gauge drains to zero in milliseconds as alert badges and AUTOMATED LIQUIDATION stamps flash.

layout.portrait: High-contrast split: top red breach alert with downward vector, center liquidation gauge, bottom broker execution ticker

transition_out.continuity: The liquidation execution stamp splits wide open into thousands of falling retail data shards

scenes.title: The Human Stampede
scenes.purpose: Dramatize the 90% retail market structure turning into an order-book vacuum and unstoppable panic selling.
scenes.visual: A massive cascade of falling glowing red order particles pouring down the vertical screen. The order book bid side flashes EMPTY while the CSI 300 index plunges off a cliff.

layout.portrait: Full-bleed vertical cascade with centered 90% retail callout and plunging telemetry line

transition_out.continuity: The falling crash vector aligns into the state rescue liquidity barrier

scenes.title: The Broken Spell
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the failure of artificial government bailouts against reflexive loss of confidence, concluding on the final $2.4T loss.
scenes.visual: State ETF liquidity barriers form in emerald green, but the selling pressure shatters through them. The screen pulls back to a stark, cinematic counter rolling to -$2.4 Trillion, holding on an ominous dark terminal.

layout.portrait: Centered monumental typography with terminal HUD borders and glowing red pulse

transition_out.continuity: Final counter and title card hold motionless with subtle pulse
